The main takeaway from our work is that

the addition of organic salts into inorganic precursors can improve the film quality and the device performance, which is expected to be a general strategy in the fabrication of inorganic solar cells.
the addition of Li-TFSI can significantly improve the performance of AgBiI4 solar cells.
the addition of a small amount of Li-TFSI could improve the film morphology of AgBiI4 and thus enhance the performance of AgBiI 4 solar cells.
